sq.q: How can a NOT gate be made using a NAND gate?
answer: A NOT gate inverts its input (i.e., outputs the opposite). To build it using a NAND gate, connect both inputs to the same signal : Y = A NAND A = A̅ . This configuration uses the NAND gate as an inverter. It demonstrates how universal gates can replicate basic functions.

sq.q: What is the difference between NAND and NOR gates?
answer: NAND is the inverse of the AND gate, while NOR is the inverse of the OR gate. NAND gives 0 only when all inputs are 1. NOR gives 1 only when all inputs are 0. Both are universal gates , meaning any logic circuit can be built from them. They are widely used in digital logic design for their versatility.
